<includeonly>{{#invoke:Display|attack|{{{1|}}}|label={{{label|Attack pattern}}}}}</includeonly><noinclude>
Use commas between cells and semicolons between rows: <nowiki>{{Attack grid|0-1,0,0-1;0,1-2,0;0-1,0,0-1}}</nowiki>.

0 is a gap; 0-1 is occupied and can roll zero damage. Cells accept integers 1 through 1000 or ordered hyphen ranges with endpoints 0 through 1000 and a positive upper endpoint. No colons or encoded decimals. Dimensions are inferred, up to 32 rows and 32 columns; every row must have the same width. Whitespace around cells is allowed, but empty cells or rows are errors. Each occupied cell has a coordinate/damage tooltip and accessible label.

Optional <code>label</code>: Attack pattern (default), Melee attack, or Ranged attack. Keep the article's headings and anchors outside the template. Sum of ranges is not maximum actual damage: overlap, armor and modifiers matter. See [[Health and armor]].
</noinclude>
